recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Future updates to Medication ingredient strength should be handled under later narrative/modeling issues rather than reapplying FHIR-25122.
issue_request: FHIR-25122 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request to add Quantity as a choice for Medication.ingredient.strength when the denominator is assumed to be one unit of administration, such as one tablet.
initial_application: Commit 80c2f73ea490c414129d8406d6d00d4e94af04c0 explicitly applied FHIR-25122 by changing the historical Medication spreadsheet type from Ratio | CodeableConcept to Ratio | CodeableConcept |Quantity and adding definition text about Quantity when the denominator is assumed to be one tablet. The 2021 source migration commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 preserved that applied change in structuredefinition-Medication.xml.
additional_context: Medication is active in source/fhir.ini, and the current source/medication/structuredefinition-Medication.xml defines Medication.ingredient.strength[x] with Ratio, CodeableConcept, and Quantity. Later Pharmacy guidance issues FHIR-36758 and FHIR-36499 refined the strength narrative/comment without removing Quantity. The parallel MedicationKnowledge issue FHIR-25295 has already been audited on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current active Medication StructureDefinition already satisfies the Jira request and there is no discovered later reversal or conflict requiring another source edit.
